reading_note: The arc traces the work of regeneration within the natural mind: first comprehending the host of false loves resident in the man, then perceiving the soul's reception of divine truth through ordered dispensation, then the daily nourishment of good which constitutes the regenerative process, then the threefold work of separation (cleansing, filtering, washing) by which what is genuine is set apart from what is adulterated, and finally the actual removal of the falsity from evil that had been intermingled in the natural. It is a teaching on how influx, received continually, performs the inner purification of the soul.

segments.spiritual_sense: Lay hold in perception of the entire company of ruling falsities and evils that have taken up residence within the natural man.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the company of ruling falsities and evil loves that govern the unregenerate natural
dwells in the proprium as its inhabitants

segments.spiritual_sense: The {3}second point: that the soul, which is the recipient vessel of life, enters inward {4} into its receptive form through the divinely ordered dispens{5}ation of truth and good.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the inmost recipient of life from the Lord
the providential ordering by which truth is administered to the man according to state

segments.spiritual_sense: Through the continual administ{5}ration of spiritual nourishment given day by day — that is, the steady influx of good and truth as daily bread — she habitually purifies the interiors, and {7}separates what is heavenly from what is not her own.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the daily bread of good and truth received by influx, which sustains regenerate life
the ongoing work of regeneration cleansing the natural
successive states of reception, each renewing life

segments.spiritual_sense: She strains and sifts {8}, drawing forth and {10}washing out from herself the adulterated mingling {11} of truth with falsity, of good with evil that had become commixed in the natural.

key_correspondences.spiritual: the separation of genuine truths from falsities mixed with them

the commixture of good with evil and truth with falsity in the unregenerate natural

segments.spiritual_sense: namely, the falsity from evil — the spiritual darkness — which had been blended and intermingled within her substance, this is what is purged away.
